etaxProblems.XML_UNREADABLE: The XML in the file is damaged or incomplete, so its values cannot be read. The supplier can send the file again.
etaxProblems.NOT_AN_ETAX_INVOICE: No electronic tax invoice was found in this file (it may be a scan, or a debit or credit note).
etaxProblems.VALUE_MISSING: The e-Tax file lacks a value or has one in the wrong form (number, date, amounts or the seller’s tax ID).
etaxProblems.TAX_ID_MISMATCH: The seller's tax ID in the file is not the supplier of this purchase order ({supplier}, tax ID {taxId}).

errors.DUPLICATE_INVOICE: This supplier already has invoice {invoiceNo} recorded (compared without spaces and letter case). Check the invoice number again; if it is the same invoice, it need not be recorded twice.
errors.EXCEEDS: The amount before VAT is more than this purchase order still holds ({remaining} baht). Record at most that much; if the supplier charges more than the order, the requesting department makes a new request for the rest.
errors.FINAL_RECORDED: The last invoice of this purchase order is recorded, so no more are taken.
errors.STATE: No invoice can be recorded on this purchase order now: it must be sent to the supplier and not cancelled. Reload the page to see its latest status.
errors.INVOICE_NO: Type the invoice number, at most 60 characters
errors.INVOICE_DATE: Choose an invoice date that exists
errors.NET: Type the amount before VAT as a number with at most 2 decimals
errors.NET_NOT_POSITIVE: The amount before VAT must be above 0
errors.VAT: Type the VAT as a number with at most 2 decimals
errors.FILE: The invoice file must be one you uploaded on this page, unchanged since. Choose the file again and retry.
errors.FILE_OTHER_PO: This file was uploaded with another purchase order, so it cannot go with an invoice of this one. Choose the file again on this page.
errors.FILE_IN_USE: This file already goes with another invoice; each invoice keeps its own file. Choose another file, or record without one.
errors.FILE_SELLER: The seller in this file is not this purchase order's supplier, so the file cannot go with the invoice. Check you chose the right file, or record without it and type the values in.
errors.FILE_TYPE: An e-Tax file is a PDF or an XML file
errors.FILE_EMPTY: This file is empty. Choose another file.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {limit} MB, so it is not accepted. Ask the supplier for the e-Tax file again, or type the invoice in without a file.
errors.REASON: Give a reason for exporting again, at least 3 characters
errors.CONFIRM: Tick that you checked the list before making the file
errors.PENDING_CHANGED: The invoices waiting for export changed after this page opened (an invoice was recorded, or someone made a file first), so no file was made. The latest list is shown now: check it and tick again.
errors.MAPPING_NOT_SET: No file was made: the Express file layout is not set yet. It has to follow a sample file that the Express program really imports. Send such a sample to your organization administrator, who passes it on to the BCS team to set the layout. No invoice was marked as exported this time.
errors.NOTHING_TO_EXPORT: No invoice is waiting for export any more; someone may have made the file already. Reload the page to see the latest file.
errors.NOTHING_TO_EXPORT_HELD: No invoice can go into the file: the {excluded, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} not exported yet wait for their supplier's Express vendor code.
errors.ENCODING: Some characters cannot be written in Windows-874 (an emoji, for example). Fix the supplier's or invoice's data, or ask your administrator to switch to UTF-8.
errors.BUDGET: The budget line of this order is closed or frozen, so the amount cannot become actual. Contact the budget administrator.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your account may not do this: it is for finance.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This purchase order or item was not found. Go back to the list and try again.
errors.BUSY: The system is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with other values. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again and retry.
errors.INVALID: The system did not accept what was sent. Reload the page and try again; if it still fails, tell the support team.
errors.SERVER: The system answered in an unexpected way. Try again in a moment; if it still fails, tell the support team.
errors.INTERNAL: Something unexpected went wrong. Tell the support team the reference {requestId}.
errors.FAILED: It did not go through because the connection failed. Check the internet connection and try again.

exports.title: Express export
exports.intro: Make the file of the invoices not exported yet, in your organization's layout, for the Express accounting program to import.

layout.notSet: No Express file can be made yet: the file layout (the columns Express takes, in order) is not set. It has to follow a sample file that Express really imports, so the system does not guess it. Send such a sample to your organization administrator, who passes it on to the BCS team to set the layout. Meanwhile the recorded invoices wait in the list below and can be exported once the layout is set.
layout.title: The organization's file layout
layout.vendorCodeNeeded: The file has a vendor code column, so invoices of suppliers without a code are kept out for now.
layout.vendorCodeNotNeeded: The file has no vendor code column, so every invoice goes in.
